description: Replace an exact block of text in a file on a specific instance (by id or exact name), leaving the rest of the file untouched. Safer than write_file for changing a single setting. Read the file first so `old_text` matches byte for byte, including indentation. Requires `confirm: true`; show the user the before/after first.

confirm.description: Must be set to true. Acts as a guard against accidental edits, so always show the user the change before setting this.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

new_text.description: The replacement text. Pass an empty string to delete `old_text`.

old_text.description: The exact text to replace. Must appear in the file, and must be unique unless `replace_all` is true.

path.description: File to edit, from the instance root, e.g. "/config/server.properties".

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring `old_text` to be unique.

name: edit_file
title: Edit File
